notes.title: Version Update 1.1.10 - Bug Fix
notes.content:
Update: A Few Bugs Just Met Their Maker 🐛💥

Greetings, adventurers!

We called in the pest control squad, and some pesky bugs have been escorted out of the game—permanently. Rest assured, your journey is now slightly less… crawly. 🕵️‍♂️

So go forth, and play, and revel in a smoother, shinier, bug-free experience! If you spot any remaining party crashers, give us a shout, and we’ll send in the exterminators again.

Happy adventuring (minus the creepy-crawlies)! 🐜🚫

notes.title: Nominate Last Christmas in the Steam Awards 2023
notes.content:
[h1]Every single vote counts![/h1]
Please take a second to nominate Last Christmas for Outstanding Story-Rich Game of 2023.

[h1]Enjoying the ride![/h1]
As a small, passionate team of game developers, our primary focus is on crafting immersive and engaging point-and-click adventure games. We believe in the power of storytelling and enjoy creating captivating narratives that allow players to embark on thrilling virtual journeys.

Our most recent release, Last Christmas, represents a milestone for us as it marks our first venture onto the Steam. This achievement has instilled a sense of pride within our team, as it opens up new opportunities for recognition and broader exposure to the gaming community.

Throughout the eventful year of 2023, we have been fortunate to connect with numerous individuals who share our love for adventure games. Building these new relationships has not only expanded our network but has also provided us with valuable feedback and insights that fuel our creative process. We are grateful for the supportive community that surrounds us, and their enthusiasm and encouragement have been instrumental in our growth.

What sets adventure games apart is their ability to transport players to imaginative worlds, challenging them with puzzles, mysteries, and thought-provoking narratives. We take great pleasure in witnessing the adventure game genre continue to thrive and evolve, capturing the imaginations of players worldwide. It is an exciting time for us as developers, as we actively contribute to the ongoing growth and innovation within this beloved genre.

Looking ahead, we are eager to keep pushing boundaries, refining our craft, and delivering memorable gaming experiences to our players. We remain committed to our passion for storytelling and aim to create even more compelling adventures that resonate with gamers and leave a lasting impact.

In summary, 2023 has been a dynamic and rewarding year for our small team of passionate developers. We are proud of our achievements thus far, grateful for the support we have received, and excited about the future of adventure gaming.

polytely games team

[h2]If you are reading this and have not yet played Last Christmas then you are in luck as it is on sale right now.[/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2129020/Last_Christmas/
